servers.name: weather-open-meteo
servers.description: Open-Meteo-backed MCP server for current weather, forecasts, timezone utilities, and air-quality indicators.

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Get current weather with temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind, pressure, cloud cover, UV, and visibility.

tools.name: get_weather_range
tools.description: Fetch weather time series for a chosen date range.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Inspect PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, CO, SO2, dust, and related air-quality indicators.

tools.name: convert_timezone
tools.description: Convert timestamps across time zones for field or study coordination.

servers.name: nasa
servers.description: NASA MCP server for Earth observation, hazard, wildfire, imagery, and POWER climate/energy data.

tools.name: nasa/power
tools.description: Query NASA POWER environmental and climate variables.

tools.name: nasa/eonet
tools.description: Track natural events through NASA EONET.

tools.name: nasa/firms
tools.description: Inspect wildfire and thermal anomaly signals from FIRMS.

tools.name: nasa/gibs
tools.description: Retrieve Earth imagery layers from GIBS.

tools.name: nasa/cmr
tools.description: Search Earth science collections and granules in CMR.

servers.name: eosc-data-commons
servers.description: EOSC Data Commons dataset-discovery MCP server for searching open-access research datasets and dataset file metadata.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search open-access datasets relevant to a research question.

tools.name: get_dataset_file_metadata
tools.description: Inspect file-level metadata for a selected dataset.
